import subprocess,json,shutil,re
if not shutil.which('adb'):
 print('ADB_NOT_INSTALLED')
 raise SystemExit(0)
p=subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=28)
print('ADB_EXIT',p.returncode)
rows=[line.strip().split() for line in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()]
print('ADB_DEVICE_COUNT',len(rows))
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
 if len(row)<2: continue
 serial,state=row[0],row[1]
 is_network=':' in serial
 print(json.dumps({'device':i,'connected':state=='device','transport':'network' if is_network else 'usb','state':state,'model':next((v.split(':',1)[1] for v in row[2:] if v.startswith('model:')),None)}))
 if state=='device':
  q=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',serial,'shell','sh','-c','echo ADB_SHELL_READY; ls -ld /sdcard/Download; if test -w /sdcard/Download; then echo DOWNLOAD_WRITABLE=yes; else echo DOWNLOAD_WRITABLE=no; fi'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
  print(json.dumps({'device':i,'probe_rc':q.returncode,'out':q.stdout[-1500:],'err':q.stderr[-400:]},ensure_ascii=False))
